title: Pin SvelteKit and Svelte Flow to a one-way folder layout

costar.context: The maintainer wants SvelteKit and Svelte Flow with Next.js-level strict plug-in patterns, and the old HTML screens converted into that app.
costar.objective: Record the folder layout and the import direction so a component or a route plugs in without a central registry.
costar.style: One section in the product rule.
costar.audience: The next coding agent and the maintainer.
costar.response: SvelteKit routes are the pages. The catalog holds components and colocated variants. Svelte Flow only renders catalog ids. The adapter is the only door to Rust.

concerns: A Svelte Flow node that draws its own buttons would fork the catalog.
A catalog component that calls the engine would bypass the adapter.
Scaffolding the SvelteKit app inside this repository would start the client before the UI tree is open.
context: The surface standard already names A2UI, tokens, and provenance folders. The framework choice is SvelteKit plus Svelte Flow.
current_state: The product rule described tokens and provenance. It did not pin SvelteKit routes, component.json discovery, or the import direction.
target_design: routes and ai-runtime may call adapter. flow and admin render catalog. catalog and token import neither adapter nor routes nor flow. component.json is discovered. Tauri wraps the build. Go may serve it.
boundaries: Do not scaffold a SvelteKit app in this pass.
Do not add a second component library for Go.

verification.name: rule-pins-kit-layout
verification.command: python -c "from pathlib import Path; t=Path(r'.cursor/rules/product-boundaries.mdc').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); keys=['SvelteKit','Svelte Flow','component.json','+page.server.ts','src/lib/catalog','src/lib/adapter']; missing=[k for k in keys if k not in t]; assert not missing, missing; print('ok')"
verification.proves: The product rule names SvelteKit, Svelte Flow, discovered component manifests, the server boundary, and the adapter.

verification.name: tree-matches-schemas
verification.proves: The plan and the other modules still match their schemas.
